market_context: U.S. equities are undergoing severe liquidation, with the Nasdaq sliding into correction territory and the VIX spiking over 57% to 26.14. Investors are rapidly unwinding AI infrastructure exposure following midterm election victories that raised concerns over state-level data center moratoriums, compounded by Qualcomm's weak smartphone chip guidance. Major indices are pinned against their intraday lows at 1:00 PM ET, suggesting negative gamma and institutional sell imbalances will dominate the final hours.

predictions.reasoning: Broad institutional deleveraging and a 57% surge in the VIX continue to suppress dip-buying appetite into the afternoon session. With SPY hovering right on its session low of $736.91 at midday, late-day market-on-close (MOC) sell imbalances are poised to push the index further toward the $733 zone.

The tech-heavy ETF has officially broken critical technical levels as Democratic congressional wins spark concerns over potential pauses on new AI data center permits. A weak midday bounce attempt quickly faded, leaving QQQ vulnerable to retesting its session low of $647.47 heading into the 4:00 PM close.

Nvidia has erased its entire year-to-date gain, breaking decisively below its $186.50 December close as investors reassess hyperscaler capital expenditures. With semiconductor selling showing no signs of stabilization, heavy options dealer hedging is likely to pull the stock down toward round-number support at $180.00.

Tesla is trading directly on its session low of $340.14, having plunged over 11.5% amid broad market risk aversion and shifting political dynamics. In heavy risk-off sessions with the 10-year yield holding firm at 4.83%, high-beta mega-caps generally face aggressive end-of-day liquidation.
